item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.23)] Surge in Data Center Power Demand Forecasted
item.description:

AEP plans to invest $78 billion to meet this demand, while Vertiv anticipates over 20% year-over-year revenue growth due to evolving data center designs. Analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating for AEP, with some recent price target adjustments.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.11)] Analog Devices Wants Robots to Think Without Nvidia | Is ADI the Next Big AI Stock?
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.11)
Analog Devices (ADI) is investing up to $200 million to acquire Alif Semiconductor, aiming to embed AI decision-making directly into devices like robots and pacemakers, bypassing cloud processing. This strategy targets the edge inference market, distinct from Nvidia's data center GPU training, focusing on low-power embedded devices. While analysts are bullish on ADI, the Alif deal's impact on revenue is expected to take several years to materialize, positioning ADI as a player in localized AI.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (-0.09)] Apple's foldable iPhone is 'not new': AT&T CEO
item.description:

He suggested that foldable phones serve a niche market and questioned whether Apple's version would significantly alter penetration dynamics, especially given the rising prices of iPhones which are causing consumers to hold onto devices longer. Stankey also discussed how AT&T plans to support new form factors and consumer purchasing behaviors.

item.title: [MSFT Bearish (-0.32)] Attackers call employees’ personal phones to break into Microsoft 365 accounts
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bearish (-0.32)
Attackers are using social engineering tactics by calling or texting employees on personal phones, posing as IT staff, to gain unauthorized access to corporate Microsoft 365 accounts. Once inside, they exploit Microsoft Graph API to extract files and emails from various applications, maintaining persistence by registering their own MFA methods. This campaign, tracked since May 2026, focuses on stealthy data exfiltration below typical detection thresholds.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.63)] Nvidia and Palantir want to speed up the AI buildout. Nvidia is first in line

The initiative aims to reduce idle inventory time for Nvidia's vast supply chain, essential for the global AI buildout, and is intended to be offered to other entities with intricate supply chain requirements.

item.title: [TSM Neutral (+0.01)] Why Taiwan’s Silicon Shield Is Failing
item.description:
Sentiment: TSM Neutral (+0.01)
Taiwan's "silicon shield," stemming from its dominance in advanced semiconductor manufacturing, is facing challenges as China invests heavily in chip self-reliance, particularly in mature-node chips. While Taiwan still holds leverage in cutting-edge chips, China's increasing capacity in 28-nanometer chips threatens to make Taiwan's shield irrelevant for its own economy, potentially leading to a more fragile global trade environment with rising chip prices. This shift means that the geopolitical importance of Taiwan's chip production will no longer solely rely on the most advanced technologies, but also on the control of common chip manufacturing.
